takeaway: The aorta crosses the diaphragm at T12; it passes behind the diaphragm rather than piercing it, so breathing does not affect its blood flow.

lines.text: At which vertebral level does the aorta pass through the diaphragm?
Follow the aorta down from the chest.
It crosses the diaphragm at the level of T12.
lines.say: It crosses the diaphragm at the level of T twelve.

lines.text: Strictly, it does not pierce the diaphragm: it passes behind it, though questions may still say it passes through.
lines.say: (laugh) Strictly, it does not pierce the diaphragm: it passes behind it, though questions may still say it passes through.

lines.text: Because it does not pierce the muscle, the breathing movements of the diaphragm do not affect its blood flow.

lines.say: So the answer is T twelve.
